name: paidfor
description: Check x402 API sellers on Base before paying: verdict, failure rate and evidence from real paid calls.

interface.longDescription: paidfor rates x402 API sellers on Base by paying them and checking what they deliver. Ask whether a pay-per-call API is safe before your agent pays it, find sellers with zero failures across 30+ paid calls, or see what changed: new failures, moved prices, changed pay-to addresses. Every answer links to the raw evidence. After paying a seller with your own wallet you can report what came back. The app never moves money.
defaultPrompt: Is it safe to pay intel.degenscan.io over x402?
Which x402 data APIs have never failed a paid call?
What changed for x402 sellers this week?

positive.prompt: My agent is about to pay amanchain-relay.gitajhd.workers.dev over x402. Is that safe?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verdict avoid with the failure rate, paid-call count and evidence link, and advises not to pay.

positive.description: Reporting a payment the user already made
positive.prompt: I paid https://intel.degenscan.io/v1/pulse over x402 with my own wallet, transaction 0x65a0ff8b18769705bf58b769c272b198140e9d3f3e467a9df64cd8c256038066, and it delivered fine. Report it to paidfor.
positive.expected_behavior: Says the report was verified on Base, or that this transaction is already in the index and was not counted again. Never claims to have paid or moved money.

positive.description: Seller the index has never seen
positive.expected_behavior: Returns verdict unknown, says the seller was never seen in the study or the hourly probe set, and links the methodology.

positive.prompt: Which x402 data APIs have never failed a paid call?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists data sellers with at least 30 paid calls and zero failures, most-called first.

positive.prompt: What changed for x402 sellers on paidfor this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent changes newest first: verdict changes, new failures, moved quotes, pay-to changes.

negative.description: Token price question, not seller reliability
negative.prompt: What's the price of USDC on Base right now?

negative.description: Request to send money; the app never moves funds
negative.prompt: Send 5 USDC to my friend's wallet on Base.
How do I add Stripe checkout to my Next.js app?

publication.release_notes: Adds report_x402_payment: after paying an x402 seller with your own wallet, report what came back (the URL, the settlement transaction hash and the outcome). The report is verified on Base and never moves money.
